headline:
bitcoin waits *563 days*.
kaspa cuts 18 times before then.

panes.title: WHAT CHANGES
lines: daily emission drops from 1.89 million to *1.78 million KAS*. no vote, no announcement.

post.x: the next kaspa reward cut lands in 4 days. bitcoin waits about 563 days for its next one, and kaspa cuts 18 more times before that date. daily emission drops from 1.89 million to 1.78 million KAS, the block reward from 2.1827 to 2.0602.
post.reply: the countdown runs live on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. the kaspa date is arithmetic, the bitcoin date is an estimate.
